<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the flavanone (product of chalcone cyclization), I will query the template catalog using the flavanone SMILES and specifying that a ketone is broken and an ether oxygen is formed. This should return templates that match the described transformation. Once a suitable template ID is obtained, I can apply it to the flavanone to generate all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C13",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": [],
    "bonds_broken": [],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
